desc:
🥚 Welcome to Speed up and Steal an Egg!

How to Play:
🏃 Run on your treadmill and through boost rings to gain Speed
🌍 Unlock new worlds, each guarded by a boss
🥚 Steal eggs from the nests and outrun the boss back to your base
🐣 Hatch eggs to collect rare pets
💰 Your pets earn money for you
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill and base
🦇 Bonk egg thieves with your bat and set bear traps
🔥 Fuse pets into stronger ones in the Fuse Machine
🌙 At night eggs grow much faster
📖 Complete the Index for rewards
✨ Discover rarer eggs, pets, sizes and mutations!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite the game for new updates!
👥 Join our group Wylentra Studios!
